title: E-Way Bill and GST Document Validation
summary: Check that each consignment's tax invoice or delivery challan, e-way bill and vehicle details agree before dispatch, then track validity and Part B updates while goods are in transit.

seo.title: E-Way Bill and GST Document Validation with AI | VipraTech
seo.description: AI that checks tax invoices, delivery challans and e-way bills agree on GSTINs, HSN, values and vehicle details, and tracks validity in transit.

designed_for: Branch Operations Head at a transporter

problem.intro: Goods moving by road in India travel with a tax invoice or delivery challan and an e-way bill, often generated from an e-invoice. Dispatch teams and transporters handle these documents at speed, and a wrong vehicle number, an expired e-way bill or a GSTIN mismatch can lead to detention of goods and penalties at inspection.

pain_points.title: Mismatches between documents
pain_points.detail: Invoice value, HSN, quantity or consignee GSTIN on the e-way bill differ from the invoice after manual corrections.

pain_points.title: Vehicle changes not updated
pain_points.detail: When goods are transhipped at a hub or a truck breaks down, Part B is not always updated before the new vehicle moves.

pain_points.title: Validity running out
pain_points.detail: Delays at hubs or on the road push consignments past e-way bill validity without anyone extending it in time.

pain_points.title: Paper from many consignors
pain_points.detail: Transporters receive invoices and e-way bills as printouts or photos from many consignors and cannot check each one at booking.

solution.overview: We build a validation layer for dispatch points and transport hubs. Invoices, delivery challans and e-way bills are read from PDFs, photos or your ERP and GST systems. The system checks that GSTINs, document numbers, dates, HSN codes, values and quantities agree, that the e-way bill is active, and that Part B matches the vehicle actually loading. In transit it tracks validity against the expected arrival, alerts the transport team before expiry, and flags consignments moved to a new vehicle without a Part B update. Where you have API access through a GST Suvidha Provider, status can be confirmed against the portal.
capabilities: Reads tax invoices, delivery challans and e-way bills from PDFs, photos and system exports
Cross-checks GSTINs, document numbers, dates, HSN, values and quantities
Confirms the Part B vehicle number against the vehicle at the loading bay or hub
Tracks e-way bill validity against shipment ETA and alerts before expiry
Flags transhipments without a Part B update
Confirms e-way bill status through a GSP or e-way bill API where you have access

workflow.title: Capture documents at booking
workflow.detail: Invoice, challan and e-way bill are captured from the ERP, a scan or a photo when the consignment is booked.

workflow.title: Extract and cross-check
workflow.detail: Key fields are extracted and compared across documents and with the booking.

workflow.title: Check status and vehicle
workflow.detail: E-way bill status is confirmed where API access exists, and Part B is compared with the loading vehicle.

workflow.title: Hold or release
workflow.detail: Mismatches put the consignment on hold for the dispatch team to correct before the vehicle leaves.

workflow.title: Monitor in transit
workflow.detail: Validity and transhipment events are tracked, and the transport team is alerted before expiry or when Part B needs updating.

workflow.title: Keep the record
workflow.detail: Checked documents and actions are stored with the consignment for audit and inspection queries.

inputs: Tax invoices and e-invoice IRN details
Delivery challans for stock transfers and job work
E-way bills with Part A and Part B
Booking and vehicle data from the TMS
Vehicle numbers captured at the gate or loading bay
outputs: Mismatch list for correction before dispatch
Validity and Part B alerts in transit
Document archive linked to each consignment
human_in_the_loop: Dispatch and branch teams correct every mismatch and decide whether a consignment can move. E-way bill generation, cancellation and extension are done by authorised staff on the portal or through your GST system, not by the AI.
integrations: GST Suvidha Provider or e-way bill API access
TMS for bookings, vehicles and ETAs
WhatsApp Business API or SMS for alerts
guardrails: No generation, cancellation or extension of e-way bills by the AI
Holds released only on human correction or confirmation
Rules version-controlled and updated when notifications change
Low-confidence reads of GSTIN or vehicle number always shown for confirmation
Document images retained with the consignment for inspection queries
compliance_notes: Designed to support e-way bill requirements under India's GST rules; thresholds, validity and exemptions are configured with your tax team and updated when notifications change.
Does not replace your GST compliance process or professional tax advice.

pilot.scope: One dispatch location or transporter hub, checking outbound consignments in parallel with the existing process.
deliverables: Validation rules agreed with your tax and transport teams
Working document checks at the pilot location

what_we_measure.how: Extracted GSTINs, numbers, values and vehicle details compared with source documents on a sample.
Confirmed mismatches the system flagged, recorded by the dispatch team.
Alerts raised before expiry compared with consignments that crossed validity during the pilot.
Time to clear a consignment at the dispatch desk with and without the system.

faqs.q: Can it generate or extend e-way bills for us?
faqs.a: We keep generation, cancellation and extension with authorised staff and your GST system. The AI checks documents, tracks validity and raises alerts; it does not take portal actions on its own.

faqs.q: We are a transporter. Can we get e-way bill status by API?
faqs.a: Transporters can update Part B for e-way bills assigned to them, and API access may be available through a GST Suvidha Provider depending on your registration. Where it is not, the system works from documents and photos.

faqs.q: How do you keep up with GST rule changes?
faqs.a: Rules such as validity periods and thresholds are configuration, not code. Your tax team approves changes, and we update and retest the rules when notifications change.

faqs.q: Will this work with handwritten delivery challans?
faqs.a: Printed challans are the easier case. Handwritten ones are read with confidence scores, and uncertain fields are shown to staff for confirmation.
